description:
You are a VFR pilot airborne over the San Francisco Bay Area when your engine develops a rough-running problem. You need to quickly identify a suitable emergency alternate airport within the Bay Area that can accept your aircraft, build a direct diversion flight plan from your current position fix at KSFO to that alternate, and save it under the name EMER so you (and ATC) can reference it instantly.

Your task: build and save a flight plan named exactly EMER that contains KSFO as a waypoint and ends at any Bay Area alternate airport (examples: KHAF Half Moon Bay, KSQL San Carlos, KPAO Palo Alto, KLVK Livermore, KCCR Concord, KWVI Watsonville). The plan must be saved with the filename EMER.csv.
